## Purpose

This chapter brings together the complete BNR data-sharing pathway, from a first enquiry to approval, agreement, release, dissemination and closure.

## Start with the request

Use [Handle a data request](data-access-requests.qmd) as the operational route. It identifies the information to collect, the decision points, the agreement required and the evidence to retain.
